response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Low","gaps":"Lack of incoming material inspection, no formal quality policy, ergonomic issues not addressed, high customer reject rate, dye lot consistency issues","recommendations":"Implement incoming material inspection procedures, develop and communicate a formal quality policy, address ergonomic complaints, reduce customer rejects through process improvements, ensure dye lot consistency","standards":"ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018"}
